entries.title: Psalms 62:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. On Jeduthun. A Psalm of David.>> Upon God alone doth my soul rest peacefully; from him is my salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 62:2
segments: He only is my rock and my salvation; my high fortress: I shall not be greatly moved.

entries.title: Psalms 62:3
segments: How long will ye assail a man; will ye [seek], all of you, to break him down as a bowing wall or a tottering fence?

entries.title: Psalms 62:4
segments: They only consult to thrust [him] down from his excellency; they delight in lies; they bless with their mouth, but in their inward part they curse. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 62:5
segments: Upon God alone, O my soul, rest peacefully; for my expectation is from him.

entries.title: Psalms 62:6
segments: He only is my rock and my salvation; my high fortress: I shall not be moved.

entries.title: Psalms 62:7
segments: With God is my salvation and my glory; the rock of my strength, my refuge is in God.

entries.title: Psalms 62:8
segments: ¶Confide in him at all times, ye people; pour out your heart before him: God is our refuge. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 62:9
segments: Men of low degree are only vanity; men of high degree, a lie: laid in the balance, they go up together [lighter] than vanity.

entries.title: Psalms 62:10
segments: Put not confidence in oppression, and become not vain in robbery; if wealth increase, set not your heart upon it.

entries.title: Psalms 62:11
segments: Once hath God spoken, twice have I heard this, that strength [belongeth] unto God.

entries.title: Psalms 62:12
segments: And unto thee, O Lord, [belongeth] loving-kindness; for *thou* renderest to every man according to his work.
